answer: Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 170 aliases, and each one needs its own funded fable account. Deposits are visible in ledge, and quill reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 30% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. A farm of 1793 identities would post 1590 proofs and burn roughly 15 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
